tool.name: collection_input_paths
tool.description: prints the input and metadata file paths each accessor gives the tool
tool.command: echo 'FOR_LOOP:#for $e in $input1# $e#end for#' > '$out' && echo 'ALL_PATHS:#for $p in $input1.all_paths# $p#end for#' >> '$out' && echo 'COLL_SERIALIZE_SOURCE:#for $s in $input1.serialize()# $s["source_path"]#end for#' >> '$out' && echo 'COLL_FOR_METADATA_PARAM:#for $e in $input1# $e.metadata.bam_index#end for#' >> '$out' && echo 'COLL_ALL_METADATA_FILES:#for $mfs in $input1.all_metadata_files##for $mf in $mfs# $mf[1]#end for##end for#' >> '$out' && echo 'COLL_SERIALIZE_METADATA:#for $s in $input1.serialize()##for $m in $s["metadata_files"]# $m["source_path"]#end for##end for#' >> '$out' && echo 'SINGLE: $single' >> '$out' && echo 'SINGLE_METADATA_PARAM: $single.metadata.bam_index' >> '$out' && echo 'SINGLE_ALL_METADATA_FILES:#for $mf in $single.all_metadata_files# $mf[1]#end for#' >> '$out' && echo 'SINGLE_SERIALIZE_METADATA:#for $m in $single.serialize()["metadata_files"]# $m["source_path"]#end for#' >> '$out' && cp '$json_paths' '$json_out'
